text: ADR-000/001/002 accepted: harness workaround, stack and layout, program defaults
PoC scope locked to VD-1..VD-6 with VD-7 as guardrail

ADR-001 addendum (backward compatible): modules may export service(ctx) mounted at ctx.modules.<name>; core registers /auth, /audit, /health; OpenAPI $refs domain JSON Schemas as single source of truth
Claim lifecycle v1: reported -> validating -> triaged -> assigned|fast_tracked -> in_review <-> pending_info -> closed (reopen by supervisor), withdrawn from any non-terminal
Sprint 5: S5-WFL-02 may create src/core/safe-pattern.mjs (Platform-owned folder) as a squad ticket; Platform reviews at sprint close
Sprint 5: R2 (devMode default off) and OIDC wiring deferred to Sprint 6; S5 OIDC is a verifier proof only, so the live IAP demo keeps working
Sprint 5: GCP credentials stay with the orchestrator; agents never run live cloud calls; IAP test grants are conditional bindings that expire in 2h or less, logged in the incidents hub

Sprint 6 goal set by sponsor feedback: production-grade UI/UX and a demo persona switcher. Design system + shell first (S6-EXP-01, strong tier: cross-app design), then four app redesigns in parallel. Visual review on screenshots is part of acceptance.

Sponsor: one program dashboard. 'FNOL Program Dashboard' (https://claude.ai/artifact/WjPCHgbBe3uCPaNoFtTXdU, dashboard/ snapshot) is the board of record; the decision network moves into it (S6-PMO-02). The live board artifact is no longer updated.
